alexj.558: Anselm Alexj came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
The rain did not stop once. Anselm Alexj slept standing up, wedged against the wall of S-F2, and dreamt of dry socks.
axelat3: Ulrich Axelat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Ulrich Axelat was number 28. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ulrich Axelat read a theatre review while peeling supper. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ulrich Axelat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich Axelat cut Valentin Zle's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Ulrich Axelat mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Ulrich Axelat stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first.
jameson.308: At the depot, Arno "Doc" Jameson had practised answering to his name. At R-F21, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A sniper's bullet hit Arno "Doc" Jameson at R-F21. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Arno "Doc" Jameson was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Arno "Doc" Jameson is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close.

Arno "Doc" Jameson spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should. A letter from home found Arno "Doc" Jameson before the night shift. Arno "Doc" Jameson folded it small and kept it close.
sean_sperring: Quentin "Mud" Sperring stepped off the supply cart at R-F19 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Quentin "Mud" Sperring taught Wendel Yaboyslydude to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Quentin "Mud" Sperring's name scratched on it. Karel Check kicked it back. It did not come again.
the_cowboii: Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was a baker in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to S-F14 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole bay knew that he collects shell fuses.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii cut his hand to the bone on the wire at the Bone Quarry. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Verdel Ridge has been won. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Tobias "Crow" Cowboii had Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony in the sights at the Chalk Pits for a long second. Severin Lagbagdotzip was lighting a pipe. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii let the match burn all the way down.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Yann Spring carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
zoric_nikola011: The quartermaster asked Karel "Button" Nikola to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Karel "Button" Nikola reported for duty as a rifleman. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Karel "Button" Nikola had Marek Izu of the Hegemony in the sights at Hill 304 for a long second. Marek Izu was lighting a pipe. Karel "Button" Nikola let the match burn all the way down.
Karel "Button" Nikola laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
